en: The image shows the address side of an old Spanish postcard labeled "TARJETA POSTAL" from the "UNION UNIVERSAL DE CORREOS". It has a red Spanish postage stamp on the upper right corner with a circular postmark. The card is addressed in cursive handwriting to "Sr Dn Benito Perez Galdós" at "Villa Sª nª Luminin" in "Santander". The bottom text notes that only the address should be written on this side.
